text:
maya: Async standup — kernel / batching / KV / perf. Quick recap:
- What I did: landed microkernel hotpatch (prefetch + small GC fix), ran KV warmup on canary infra, saw ~7% 99p tail improvement.
- Blockers: canary fail in us-west2 with repeated evictions / one OOM. Need help root-causing eviction logic + memory pressure.
- Today: revert canary if unstable, add cap to prefetch buffer, add heap diff tests, open PR for config flag. Ping @jordan for review.

jordan: Copy. Will look at the PR now. For the canary failure, I noticed batch sizing jitter in logs — could be causing larger-than-expected allocations. Can you paste the bench command + logs?

maya: bench command I used:
```
./bin/bench --model redwood-v1 --seq 1024 --batch 4 --kv-warmup=true --eviction-threshold=0.7 --stress-alloc=false
```
Quick result: before patch 99p=92ms, after prefetch patch 99p=86ms. From canary logs: `evict loop triggered=12 times in 5m; pod mem_used=5.8G; jvm/rt heap_*`

liam: I can take a look at heap diffs. Last night on the nightly run we saw short-lived GC spikes aligning with bursty requests. Suggest trying microbatch_max 32->16 on the canary to reduce transient allocations.

sophia: I'll spin a canary with microbatch_max=16 and route 5% traffic. ETA ~20m. Also rebased the batching PR to remove a flakey test.

maya: thanks @sophia. PR link is #4123 (added in the thread). @jordan please double-check the eviction edgecases; unit tests would be ideal.

jordan: on it. Two quick nits in the PR comments, and I recommend adding a test for eviction heuristic when kv_warmup toggles on/off.

eng-bot: deploybot: Canary deploy started: service=runtime-canary-3, env={microbatch_max:16}, route=5%, build=b492f. Status: 2/3 pods ready, 1 pod OOMKilled.

maya: Confirmed OOM on one pod — reverting canary for now. Blocker: memory growth when prefetch buffer hits N items after microbatch change. I can reproduce locally with `--stress-alloc`.

liam: If you need a heap profile, run with `GOGC=50` and enable pprof at :6060, then `go tool pprof http://localhost:6060/debug/pprof/heap`. I can take the diff once you have two snapshots.

sophia: I'll open an internal issue and paste the logs + bot output, assigning to @maya and @liam. Also adding a line in the weekly perf deck to track 99p tail improvements post-fix.

maya: Plan: 1) revert canary -> 2) instrument prefetch to cap by bytes (not items) and add defensive checks -> 3) add heap diff unit test -> 4) re-run canary with microbatch_max=16 and 5% traffic. Timeline: aim to finish investigation + fix by EOD PST. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
